data.desc: Founded in 2008, Enlight Renewable Energy is a leading global renewable energy developer and independent power producer operating in the United States, Israel and Europe. The company manages the full project lifecycle, developing, financing, constructing, owning and operating utility-scale solar, wind and energy storage projects. Enlight is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ENLT and is a prominent constituent of the TA-35 Index. As of September 30, 2026, Enlight's total portfolio stood at 46.2 FGW, including 12.7 FGW in its mature portfolio.
